description: Record one or more transactions (expense, income, transfer between own accounts, debt_out / debt_in with a person). Amounts are positive in the account currency. Without a category, one is picked from this payee's history or ZenMoney suggestions (auto_categorize). Returns the created transactions, updated balances and possible-duplicate warnings.

auto_categorize.description: Fill a missing expense/income category from history or ZenMoney suggestions

dry_run.description: Preview the outcome without saving anything

account.description: Account name, id or card last digits (source account for transfers and debt_out)

amount.description: Amount in the account's currency (for transfers: amount leaving `account`)

category.description: Category name, "Parent / Child" path or id

original_amount.description: Expense/income/debt: amount in the original currency when it differs from the account currency (e.g. 10 USD paid from a RUB card)

payee.description: Payee / merchant; for debt operations the person

to_amount.description: Transfers only: amount arriving in to_account; required when the currencies differ

type.description: expense | income | transfer (between own accounts) | debt_out (money given to a person: lending, or repaying them) | debt_in (money received from a person: borrowing, or them repaying you)

name: create_transactions
title: Add transactions
